Answer.signature: Answer(blocks: (Text | Gauge | Stat | Resource | Steps | Image | Embed)[])
Answer.description: The root container. Holds an ordered sequence of blocks that together answer the student's question.

Text.description: A short paragraph of plain prose. Use for explanation and context between visual blocks.

Gauge.signature: Gauge(trackId: string, name: string, provenLevel: number, requiredLevel: number, weeksToClose: number, note: string)
Gauge.description: A skill track gauge showing what the student has proven against what the role requires. Use when discussing a specific track's level. Always take the numbers from a tool result — never estimate them.

Stat.signature: Stat(label: string, value: string, caption?: string)
Stat.description: A single labelled number, e.g. readiness or open gap count. Use sparingly, for the figure the answer turns on.

Resource.signature: Resource(title: string, url: string, source: string, summary: string, tags?: string[])
Resource.description: A link to a course, project or repository, with what it closes. Only use URLs returned by a tool.

Steps.description: An ordered list of concrete next actions. Each item should be something the student could start today.

Image.signature: Image(url: string, alt: string, caption?: string, href?: string)
Image.description: A thumbnail or screenshot for a link. Only use an image URL returned by preview_link — never construct one, and never use an image you have not verified exists.

Embed.description: An inline YouTube or Vimeo player. Only use when preview_link returned a videoProvider and videoId — pass those exact values.
